final: WITH winners AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS batting_hand FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id) SELECT batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS manager_count, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) FROM winners) AS share FROM winners GROUP BY batting_hand ORDER BY batting_hand
